intermediate.name: Riyueshan Mountain Pass
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (3) Riyueshan Mountain Pass (84.8 km)

story: A ferocious opening hour averaged 56 kph, preventing any breakaway. Caja Rural split the peloton on the climb, reducing it to around 50 riders. A 15-rider group featuring race leader Jonathan Caicedo then attacked beside the lake, but Astana helped reel it in. Caja Rural subsequently delivered a perfect lead-out for Iúri Leitão, who won the sprint.
